description: This file defines an interface class IEventHandler within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The interface declares four pure virtual methods for handling various events related to runtime, window, ripple, and state change events, each accepting JSON data or a string and JSON data.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface class for handling various lifecycle and event notifications, requiring implementation of four event handler methods.

methods.name: onRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles runtime manager events, receiving event data as a JsonObject reference.

methods.name: onWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles window manager events, receiving event data as a JsonObject reference.

methods.name: onRippleEvent
methods.description: Handles ripple events, receiving a name string and event data as a JsonObject reference.

methods.name: onStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles state change events, receiving event data as a JsonObject reference.
